description: SYNTHETIC feature-level driving scenarios: one row per 10 Hz step of a constructed scenario. Not observations. Separate from the real event dataset (data/events/).
provenance_policy: Every row is SYNTHETIC: data_source=SYNTHETIC, observation_type=SYNTHETIC, timestamp_source=SYNTHETIC, gps_source=SYNTHETIC, location_source=SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE. Inputs (boxes, driver signals, time, location) are constructed by the generator; engine outputs are computed by the existing, unmodified tracker / driver / risk / event code FROM those synthetic inputs and are therefore synthetic too. Rows are written only to data/simulated/ and never to the real dataset (data/events/). parent_real_event_id only references an existing LOCAL_REAL event used as a statistical reference; it does not make the row an observation.
statement: Synthetic data does not replace real observations. It stress-tests the existing risk/event logic with controlled feature-level scenarios; it says nothing about how often these situations occur on real roads or whether the engine is correct on real driving.

field_provenance.SYNTHETIC_INPUT: constructed by the generator (time, location, boxes, labels, confidences, driver signals, design ground truth)
field_provenance.ENGINE_ON_SYNTHETIC: computed by the existing, unmodified tracker / driver temporal logic / RiskEngine / EventRecorder from the synthetic inputs
field_provenance.VALIDATION: expected qualitative behaviour vs the engine's actual output

units: Image-space pixels and seconds. No metres, physical speed, distance or TTC.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Simulated-dataset schema version.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Sequential id within a run: event_000001, event_000002, ... (deterministic). SYNTHETIC dataset: row id sim_000001, sim_000002, ... (never an event_NNNNNN real id).

fields.name: synthetic_id
fields.description: Stable descriptive row id: SYN-<scenario>-v<variant>-s<step>.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Identifier of the recording/processing run that produced the event. SYNTHETIC dataset: generator run id.

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: Stream the event belongs to (e.g. the source video's file stem). SYNTHETIC dataset: scenario instance: <scenario>__v<variant>.

fields.name: scenario_name
fields.description: Scenario name (one of the 12 designed scenarios).

fields.name: scenario_variant
fields.description: Variant index of the scenario (different seed-derived parameters).

fields.name: scenario_description
fields.description: What the scenario constructs.

fields.name: synthetic_generation_reason
fields.description: Why the scenario exists (what it stress-tests).

fields.name: parent_real_event_id
fields.description: LOCAL_REAL road event (event_NNNNNN in parent_real_run_id) used as a statistical reference for the constructed road object; null = synthetic-only parameters.

fields.name: parent_real_driver_event_id
fields.description: LOCAL_REAL driver-camera event used as a reference for the constructed driver signals; null if none.

fields.name: parent_real_run_id
fields.description: Run id of the real dataset the parent ids belong to.

fields.name: data_source
fields.description: LOCAL_REAL (our own captures) | PUBLIC | SYNTHETIC (constructed test inputs) | SYNTHETIC_COMBINATION (real streams combined although not recorded together). Synthetic records live in a separate dataset. SYNTHETIC dataset: always SYNTHETIC.

fields.name: observation_type
fields.description: Always SYNTHETIC: nothing in this row was observed.

fields.name: camera
fields.description: Which camera stream(s) the event is based on. SYNTHETIC dataset: virtual front+driver pair (no video exists).

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Stream time of the event, seconds (video timestamps for files). SYNTHETIC dataset: seconds since the start of the scenario instance on a fixed synthetic cadence.

fields.name: timestamp_source
fields.description: Always SYNTHETIC.

fields.name: synthetic_datetime
fields.description: ISO-8601 time on a synthetic clock (base_datetime + offsets). Not a capture time.

fields.name: frame_index
fields.description: Index of the frame that produced the event, when known. SYNTHETIC dataset: step index within the scenario instance (no frames exist).

fields.name: gps_lat
fields.description: Latitude from a real GPS source; null when unavailable. Never invented. SYNTHETIC dataset: SYNTHETIC coordinate around a generic reference point; NOT a collection location.

fields.name: gps_lon
fields.description: Longitude from a real GPS source; null when unavailable. Never invented. SYNTHETIC dataset: SYNTHETIC coordinate around a generic reference point; NOT a collection location.

fields.name: gps_source
fields.description: GPS source name, or UNAVAILABLE. SYNTHETIC dataset: always SYNTHETIC.

fields.name: location_source
fields.description: Always SYNTHETIC_REFERENCE.

fields.name: driver_hand_state
fields.description: Hand-state classifier output (BOTH_HANDS / ONE_HAND / NO_HANDS / UNKNOWN). SYNTHETIC dataset: scripted hand state fed to the existing driver temporal logic.

fields.name: driver_hand_confidence
fields.description: Hand-state classifier confidence. SYNTHETIC dataset: scripted classifier confidence.

fields.name: face_status
fields.description: Driver face-landmark status for the frame. SYNTHETIC dataset: scripted face status.

fields.name: head_yaw
fields.description: Scripted head yaw, degrees (relative head-pose signal).

fields.name: head_pitch
fields.description: Scripted head pitch, degrees (> 0 = down).

fields.name: eye_closure_ratio
fields.description: Share of the rolling window with eyes closed (existing EyeClosureTracker on scripted eye openness).

fields.name: eye_closed_duration
fields.description: Current continuous eye closure, seconds (existing EyeClosureTracker).

fields.name: drowsiness_score
fields.description: Temporal drowsiness score 0-1 (prototype). SYNTHETIC dataset: existing drowsiness scoring on scripted eye signals.

fields.name: drowsiness_level
fields.description: Temporal drowsiness level (prototype, not medically validated). SYNTHETIC dataset: existing drowsiness scoring on scripted eye signals.

fields.name: driver_activity
fields.description: Inferred driver activity (NORMAL, HANDS_OFF_WHEEL, ...). SYNTHETIC dataset: existing activity inference (NO_HANDS >= 2 s -> HANDS_OFF_WHEEL).

fields.name: distraction_duration
fields.description: Continuous INFERRED manual-distraction time, seconds (existing driver logic); 0.0 if none.

fields.name: manual_state_duration
fields.description: Continuous time in the current hand/manual state, seconds (existing StateDurationTracker).

fields.name: head_away_duration
fields.description: Continuous time the head pose has been 'away' by the risk rules (existing HeadAwayTimer), seconds.

fields.name: image_width
fields.description: Front-camera frame width in pixels. SYNTHETIC dataset: virtual frame width.

fields.name: image_height
fields.description: Front-camera frame height in pixels. SYNTHETIC dataset: virtual frame height.

fields.name: hazard_class
fields.description: Detector label of the primary object at the event time. SYNTHETIC dataset: detector label of the constructed detection (may flicker by design); null when the object was not detected this step.

fields.name: hazard_confidence
fields.description: Detector confidence of the primary object at the event time. SYNTHETIC dataset: constructed detector confidence.

fields.name: center_x
fields.description: Primary object box centre x, pixels. SYNTHETIC dataset: constructed box.

fields.name: center_y
fields.description: Primary object box centre y, pixels. SYNTHETIC dataset: constructed box.

fields.name: bbox_width
fields.description: Primary object box width, pixels. SYNTHETIC dataset: constructed box.

fields.name: bbox_height
fields.description: Primary object box height, pixels. SYNTHETIC dataset: constructed box.

fields.name: bbox_area
fields.description: Primary object box area, pixels². SYNTHETIC dataset: constructed box.

fields.name: primary_track_id
fields.description: Tracker id of the object driving the hazard (identity is inferred). SYNTHETIC dataset: tracker id of the scenario's road object (requested name: object_id).

fields.name: hazard_track_class
fields.description: Track-level label (most frequent detector label of the track). SYNTHETIC dataset: track-level label from the existing IoUTracker.

fields.name: track_persistence_seconds
fields.description: How long the primary track has been observed. SYNTHETIC dataset: existing IoUTracker.

fields.name: box_growth_per_second
fields.description: Risk-engine growth: slope of ln(box area) over ~1 s (relative approach signal, not distance). SYNTHETIC dataset: requested name: approach_rate. Existing risk-engine feature (slope of ln area); null until enough history.

fields.name: lateral_toward_center_fw_per_s
fields.description: Horizontal motion toward/across the central image band, frame-widths per second. SYNTHETIC dataset: existing risk-engine feature.

fields.name: trajectory_overlap
fields.description: Reserved: overlap of the object's path with the vehicle's projected path. Always null until a calibrated path model exists. SYNTHETIC dataset: DESIGN GROUND TRUTH: fraction of the constructed box width inside the central image band (|x-0.5| <= 0.2 of the frame width). Image-space only, not a calibrated vehicle path, and NOT an input to the risk engine. (Always null in the real dataset.)

fields.name: hazard_persistence
fields.description: How long this hazard (same hazard type and track) has been continuously reported, seconds. SYNTHETIC dataset: continuous time the risk engine has reported the object as a qualifying road hazard, seconds; 0.0 when not reported.

fields.name: risk_level
fields.description: Risk level after hysteresis (decision-support state, not validated). SYNTHETIC dataset: existing RiskEngine after hysteresis.

fields.name: raw_risk_level
fields.description: Existing RiskEngine level for this step alone (after gates, before hysteresis).

fields.name: raw_risk_score
fields.description: Rule-based prototype score 0-100 for this observation. Not a probability.

fields.name: smoothed_risk_score
fields.description: Smoothed prototype score 0-100. Not a probability.

fields.name: risk_score
fields.description: RiskAssessment.risk_score (= smoothed_risk_score): rule-based prototype score 0-100, not a probability.

fields.name: hazard_type
fields.description: Risk engine hazard type (NONE, APPROACHING_VEHICLE, ...).

fields.name: risk_reason
fields.description: Reason generated by the rule engine from structured factors (no LLM).

fields.name: risk_factors
fields.description: Contributing factors [{name, points, source, detail, track_id}].

fields.name: risk_gates
fields.description: Level caps applied by the risk engine.

fields.name: evidence_quality
fields.description: 0-1 support of the evidence behind the risk result (not a probability).

fields.name: alarm_recommended
fields.description: Risk engine recommendation (level >= configured alarm level).

fields.name: alarm_triggered
fields.description: Whether an alarm was actually raised. Always false: no alarm output exists yet. SYNTHETIC dataset: always false: no alarm output exists.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Event the existing EventRecorder emitted at this step (first if several); null if none.

fields.name: transition
fields.description: FROM->TO for level and driver-state changes, e.g. SAFE->CAUTION. SYNTHETIC dataset: transition of that event.

fields.name: events_emitted
fields.description: All events the existing EventRecorder emitted at this step: ["TYPE FROM->TO", ...].

fields.name: expected_behavior
fields.description: Expected qualitative behaviour of the scenario instance (written before running the engine).

fields.name: expected_peak_levels
fields.description: Acceptable peak risk levels for the scenario instance.

fields.name: actual_risk_level
fields.description: Risk level the existing engine produced at this step (= risk_level).

fields.name: instance_peak_risk_level
fields.description: Highest risk level the engine produced in this scenario instance.

fields.name: expectation_met
fields.description: Whether the instance's actual behaviour matched the expectation (same value on every row of the instance).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Provenance and limitation notes for this record. SYNTHETIC dataset: provenance notes.
